quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time, who goes first?

options.text: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
The vehicle on the right must yield to the vehicle on the left.
Drivers must use hand signals to talk to each other.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, vehicles go in the order they arrive. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the one on the left must let the one on the right go first.

questions.question: What does a flashing red light mean?

options.text: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
You do not have to come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely, just like at a stop sign. Check that it is safe before you proceed.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Keep them straight and set the parking brake.
Turn them away from the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn them away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels away from the curb when parking uphill. If your brakes fail, your car will roll into the curb instead of into traffic.

questions.question: At night, what is hardest to see while driving?
questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians are harder to see at night than road signs and other objects.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow sign warns you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, what should they do?

options.text: They will drive the same as normal.
They can drive faster because they are more alert.
They should calm down and focus before they start driving.
They should call a friend while driving to feel better.

questions.correctAnswerText: They should calm down and focus before they start driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions like worry, anger, or sadness make it harder to drive safely. Your mind may not focus on the road. Always take time to relax and think clearly before you drive.

questions.question: If you cannot see well while driving, what should you do first?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Always slow down first when you cannot see well. This is the best way to handle poor visibility and dangerous road conditions.

questions.question: At night, a car is coming toward you from the opposite direction. What should your headlights be on?

options.text: Off, with only parking lights on.
Either high or low beam is fine.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when another car is coming toward you at night. High beams will blind the other driver and create a safety risk.

questions.question: Can you drive around or under a railroad crossing gate that is moving?

options.text: Yes, if the train is not too close.
Yes, if your vehicle will not hit the gate.
Yes, if you look both ways carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, never.
questions.explanation: When you see flashing red lights, bells, or lowered gates at a railroad crossing, you must stop completely. Do not try to go around or under the gate. Wait until the lights and bells stop and the gate is fully raised before crossing.

questions.question: What lane space are motorcycles entitled to?

options.text: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the full width of a lane, just like cars and trucks.

questions.question: Why should drivers be extra alert around motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws than cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians cause many crashes because drivers don't see them. These road users are smaller, move quickly, and have less noticeable lights than cars. Drivers must stay alert to avoid hitting them.

questions.question: What should you do when a driver behind you wants to pass?

options.text: Slow down to give them room to pass safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give them room to pass safely.
questions.explanation: When a driver behind you wants to pass, slow down. This creates space in front of your vehicle so they can pass more easily and quickly.

questions.question: What should you do when you see or hear an emergency vehicle?

options.text: Stop right away and let the vehicle pass.
Move to the right side of the road as safely as possible and stop.
Drive slowly and let the vehicle pass.
Keep moving slowly on the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right side of the road as safely as possible and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle is coming, move as far to the right as you safely can and stop. Do not stop in an intersection. You must yield to emergency vehicles using lights and sirens, no matter which direction they are coming from.

questions.question: On a multilane, one-way street, which lane should you use to turn left?
questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane.
questions.explanation: To turn left from a multilane, one-way street, start from the left lane.

questions.question: How should you enter a freeway?

options.text: Signal, let other traffic pass, and enter at the same speed as traffic.
Signal and enter. Other drivers must let you in.
Drive slowly so you can see the traffic.
Always come to a complete stop first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, let other traffic pass, and enter at the same speed as traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging onto a freeway, signal and match the speed of traffic. Always yield to other drivers when entering.

questions.question: What are signs that warn about dangerous conditions called?
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to possible dangers ahead. Follow these signs to stay safe. Ignoring a warning sign can lead to an accident.

questions.question: What should you assume when passing a vehicle that just parked on the side of the road?

options.text: The driver will open the door as you approach.
The driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver will open the door as you approach.
questions.explanation: Assume the driver will open their door as you pass. Use extra caution around parked vehicles.

questions.question: If you notice a problem with your vehicle that affects safe driving, what should you do?

options.text: Fix it when you have money.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fix it right away.
questions.explanation: Any vehicle problem that affects safe driving must be fixed as soon as possible before you drive again.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, what happens?

options.text: Your body breaks it down faster.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your reactions slow down.
questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your body, your reactions slow down. You may feel more confident but actually make more mistakes.

questions.question: When may you drive around the gates at a railroad crossing?
questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: You must stop at all railroad crossings when warning signals are active. These signals include flashing red lights, lowered gates, a person signaling, or the train's horn. Never go around a lowered gate.

questions.question: It starts to rain while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Drive close behind the car in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: When rain makes it hard to see, slow down. Turn on your headlights so other drivers can see you. If the rain is very heavy and you cannot see clearly, pull to the side of the road and stop until it improves.

questions.question: When you are about to turn left, you should:

options.text: Slow down gradually while checking your rearview mirror.
Watch for oncoming cars and pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Before turning left, signal 3 to 5 seconds ahead. Check your rearview mirror and slow down gradually. On a road with multiple lanes, move into the left lane before you reach the intersection. Wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear, then turn.

questions.question: When can you carefully drive through an intersection with a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If the yellow light appears while you are already in the intersection, you can carefully continue through.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, which lane should you use?

options.text: The lane closest to the lane you were just in.
The lane marked with an arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to the lane you were just in.
questions.explanation: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, use the lane closest to your previous lane. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Wrong-direction entry onto one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-direction entry onto one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way traffic. You cannot enter from your current direction.
